service.description: IRON's intake and two requests made through it, by the real paths (loading again changes nothing that is there): - the intake: the Support account (BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_SUPPORT, support@ziziwork.example) with the plus tag iron, the rule BOSS_DEMO_MAIL_R_INTAKE_IRON of its owner john.doe (To contains support+iron@ziziwork.example: createRequest IRON), the public form's link BossDemoIronIntakeForm1, John Doe the triage assignee, Bug Fix the default type; - a message from Dana Reyes (dana.reyes@acme.example) in the Support Inbox, run through the account's rules (org.moqui.mail.EmailClientServices.run#EmailRules), so the rule makes its request; - a request sent through the form (mantle.request.RequestServices.create#IntakeRequest with the token) by Sam Patel. Each part on its own: one that fails is logged and the rest go on. The settings, the rule and the message are each written in a transaction of their own, as the rule's action reads them in its own (the loader runs a data file in one transaction, impl-projects.md F27).
